{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|After mating, H'nemthe females gut the males with those tongues of theirs&mdash;they're as sharp as sword blades, and a lot stronger than they look. Some kind of biological reaction to there being twenty H'nemthe males for every female. The males seem to think it's worth it, to achieve the act of love.|[[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], to [[Predne Balu]]|audio=HnemtheFemales-Nightlily.flac|<ref name="Nightlily">{{StoryCite|story=Nightlily: The Lovers' Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>}}
The '''[[H'nemthe (species)/Legends|H'nemthe]] mating ritual''' was a gruesome act in which the female would gut the male with her razor tongue following sexual intercourse, thought to have been driven biologically by the fact that male outnumbered female H'nemthe twenty-to-one. Other races looked upon this as barbaric, though male H'nemthe thought it would be worth it.<ref name="Nightlily" />

[[Feltipern Trevagg/Legends|Feltipern Trevagg]] was killed by [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|M'iiyoom Onith]] during a mating ritual.<ref name="Nightlily" />
